title: Viral and Bacterial Decontamination
body: Now, more than ever, we as a country feel the need to be safe in our homes and places of work. Trying to clean the area you spend your time in with 100% efficiency can be near impossible and with the best will in the world, decontaminating every nook and cranny is impractical.

As well as pest control in Halifax we also can sanitise your building. We provide a service that can get where you can't. We use specialised Fogging and Electrostatic Spraying equipment and Industry leading Decontaminant Formulations to sanitise all kinds of areas, from Homes to Offices.
In a well ordered, tidy house we can normally be finished within the hour (product kills 99.99% of Viruses and Bacteria including Covid-19).
